modalMaterial.scope: Shared legacy and owned Dialog decoration; existing palette and original interactive content retained.
modalMaterial.sample: Owning Activity decor at 1/12 resolution; two CPU separable box-blur passes, radius 4 in the sampled bitmap; positioned relative to owner/decor screen origins.
modalMaterial.alphaScope: Baseline tonal values. R7 applies the configured panel opacity once across snapshot/tonal composition, preserving proportions rather than independently fading both layers. Foreground/wallpaper and opaque QR content are outside this budget.
modalMaterial.boardCorners: 28dp warm/mono; 16dp cyan, drawn outside the generic radius-cap helper, with a thin theme outline.
modalMaterial.content: Sharp text and controls over transparent root/scroll hosts; field, selected and focus backgrounds stay meaningful.
modalMaterial.lifecycle: Bounded open/owner-resize/theme refresh. Keyed Board replacement/detach releases bitmap/listeners and animated-border scheduling/callback. No per-frame sampling or replacement of external dismiss callbacks.
modalMaterial.callbacks: Original external dismiss/close callbacks are retained.
modalMaterial.persistence: Panel snapshot stays only in application memory and is never persisted.
modalMaterial.limits: App-owned snapshot panel; no system realtime cross-window blur, ordinary View capture of SurfaceView content, or vehicle-performance acceptance.

themeBehavior.modeToggle: Toggle current scheme; one saved mode flag, not per-theme mode history.

poster.identity: User-supplied public poster copied byte-identically; local asset SHA independently matched.
poster.display: Whole original raster via FIT_CENTER on opaque white, preserving aspect/quiet space; no crop or tint.
poster.scope: Public community provenance poster, distinct from live private account-login QR images.

sourceInfo.dialog: Owner-sized width/height caps 620dp/860dp at reference sizes; poster consumes remaining height; fixed 打开官方社区/关闭 row with 52dp minimum targets and 12dp gap.
sourceInfo.rotation: SourceInfo.resize participates in CarUi.refreshDialog; no separate visual system.
sourceInfo.behavior: Only explicit community-button selection launches ACTION_VIEW for the exact URL. Opening/closing About does not launch a browser or commit theme/appearance/wallpaper preferences.

appearance.implementation: Appearance.Edge extends native GradientDrawable; shared panel material only.
appearance.entry: Bounded 主题中心 with scrolling controls/material preview, fixed Apply/Cancel footer and 壁纸中心 title action.
appearance.transparency: 0–100; 0 opaque/100 transparent. Fill opacity is baseline alpha * (100-transparency)/100. Text, icons, wallpaper and opaque QR quiet zones are not faded.
appearance.colorScope: Feature edge-color choices, separate from wallpaper choices and normative Skin roles.
appearance.draft: Changes update the sample only. Cancel and opening Wallpaper Center do not save. Apply, a theme row or day/night choice commits appearance together; the combined action is stated visibly.
appearance.windowBounds: min(owner width-40dp,620dp) x min(owner height-48dp,760dp); scrolling controls with fixed footer.
appearance.functionalStates: Focus/pressed boundaries remain functional; decorative edge drawing yields to those states.
appearance.flow: 8s linear cycle, draw-driven 33ms invalidation, one pending tick; hidden/closed/no-callback edges do not continue scheduling.
appearance.animationReduction: API26+ checks ValueAnimator.areAnimatorsEnabled at draw and uses static edge when disabled. API17–25 reads animator scale at drawable creation only.
appearance.limits: Scheduler/hidden/reduced-animation checks are local; old-API hardware, all-theme/device matrices, GPU/power and long-running vehicle performance are not accepted.

wallpaper.scope: Optional application main-shell/hosted-workspace background, not a system launcher WallpaperService.
wallpaper.entry: 主题中心 title-row 壁纸中心 and original Settings/Advanced/修改管家背景 action open the same wallpaper center.

staticSources.entry: 选择静态壁纸 · 按屏幕裁切; default-star/moon restoration is a separate action.
staticSources.original: Original AppStart bj_2 star/moon asset, with 0.7/0.25 focal placement in both orientations.
staticSources.legacy: Prior private bj.png/jpg option only appears when present; decode edge bounded to 2048 and original file never modified/deleted.
staticSources.selected: Local image document to bounded async decode/crop/private draft, then wallpaper preview and explicit Apply.

wallpaper.optionScope: Feature choices/user configuration; do not replace the normative shared Skin color roles.
wallpaper.controlRanges: Particle speed/density: 0–100. Background-strength control removed in R7.
wallpaper.legacyStrength: Existing strength key/default 70 remains serialized for compatibility but is ignored by rendering.
wallpaper.renderingLayer: Shared veil fully removed in R7 for static/star-moon/solid/particle/video. Preview and applied wallpaper retain their own authored colors/alpha. Off uses current theme canvas. Global transparency affects panels separately.
wallpaper.editor: Bounded preview above scrolling controls in portrait, beside controls at >=720dp available width; fixed Apply/Cancel footer. Owner resize updates existing Editor bounds/draft/scroll rather than rebuilding them.

cropper.aspect: Actual owning-window screen ratio; pan/pinch, keyboard movement/zoom, Reset and rotation preserving crop center/relative zoom.
cropper.sourceDecode: Async; longest edge 4096 and approximately 8MP bound, API24+ EXIF orientation handling.
cropper.savedCropDisplayDecode: R7 permits 4096px/~8MP, avoiding former 2048px secondary halving; legacy bj.png/jpg keeps its separate bound.
cropper.largeOutputLimit: Aspect retained; longest edge 2560 and approximately 4MP maximum.
cropper.draft: 使用裁切 creates a private app-owned draft copy; only Apply commits it. Cancel removes unsaved copies; replacement cleanup is confined to the dedicated private image directory; originals remain unchanged.
cropper.evidenceBoundary: Target output pixels verified by local native geometry tests, not by reading private VM JPEG metadata. VM pan/keyboard zoom/rotation observed; pinch implemented but not injected.

wallpaper.controlTints: Native SeekBar uses theme accent for thumb/progress and outline for track; energy-saving CheckBox uses accent checked/muted unchecked. Final VM tint evidence is cyan; not a hardware/all-theme guarantee.
wallpaper.video: Platform MediaPlayer + TextureView, muted looping, centered crop. ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT requests video/*, OPENABLE and EXTRA_LOCAL_ONLY; content URI must be readable and persistent read access is requested when available.
wallpaper.draftAndGrants: Native result Fragment carries draft/unused grant across picker/state restoration. Apply saves car_wallpaper_v1; Cancel releases new unused access and preserves previous saved URI/grant. Replacement/removal Apply releases old access when stored URI changes; Off may retain URI for reuse.
wallpaper.lifecycle: Particles schedule bounded 33ms invalidation only while attached/active/visible and not still. Video resources are released on hidden/pause/detach/source change. Static mode stops repeated particle ticks or holds video playback.
wallpaper.fallback: Native feedback and readable solid/theme-blended fallback for unavailable chooser, unreadable source, nonpersistent permission or decoder failure.
wallpaper.limits: App-shell feature only; no measured frame-rate, universal image/video contrast, all-codec, power or vehicle-performance guarantee. Runtime engine/final phases and their narrower gesture/picker limits remain separate.

layoutContracts.genericComposition: Protect compact interactive groups and content widgets, while a recognized dialog content panel still composes when its original listener consumes panel clicks. Unknown adapter rows retain structure. WRAP_CONTENT selectors are not elastic; retain positive-height local lists/plain-View geometry and synchronize elastic wrappers with original visibility.
layoutContracts.functions: fragment_cmd/v_ts is a measured footer below the elastic original grid, including after late text binding.
layoutContracts.automation: Wrapping compact horizontal header actions; item_laboratory uses an icon beside a wrapping description and retains original callbacks.
layoutContracts.fileLocations: item_root/v_pathName is a horizontal location row with complete visible label bounds, original colored artwork and aspect ratio; it is not a category or checkbox selector.
layoutContracts.networkRows: MT-style independent cloud/local panes remain side by side in both orientations with separate source/path, single-column flat file rows, states and bottom toolbars. Original thumbnail/icon/badge/name/metadata/selection Views and callbacks remain.
layoutContracts.providerChoices: Original TV list/adapter with native V7Grid; 1–4 columns determined by available width and font scale, wrapping horizontally while retaining original positions and Close.
layoutContracts.qrLogin: Original image/state/container contract, untinted FIT_CENTER bitmap inside bounded opaque-white square with 18dp quiet zone and fixed Close. Global transparency does not fade code/state surface. Layout evidence is not scan/authentication acceptance.
layoutContracts.overlays: Retain positive original dimensions; visible HiveProgressView keeps its original bounded 100dp square and supported accent color role.
layoutContracts.emptyStates: Show selection or directory-empty guidance only for an empty adapter without visible loading/error; choose the message from actual path state.
layoutContracts.compactDialogs: Use owning Activity bounds; wrap actual content with a bounded height, horizontal full-width choice rows and a 380dp cap for dialog_menu. The installer-mode menu and installed-app chooser are separate paths.
layoutContracts.fullDialogs: Explicit settings/shell/media/DIY and bounded file/form roles may receive the bounded full-dialog height; compact menus remain content-sized. Preserve original scroll viewports, fixed bottom actions and grouped settings hierarchy.
layoutContracts.viewportRoles: Distinguish fixed geometry, content-height selectors, bounded original ScrollView/NestedScrollView and genuine remaining-space content before reparenting. Preserve fixed actions and region-specific state layers; nonpositive height alone does not define a workspace.
layoutContracts.mappingWorkspaces: Float/DIY retain key-to-map columns; sidebar adds region-to-key-to-map. One shared remaining-height workspace sits below the command strip, with flexible map width and full original help afterward. Former decorative separator instances are retained outside content measurement.
layoutContracts.actionGroups: Wrap complete original action groups by measured width, including compact horizontal action-only groups; keep the title and main viewport distinct.
layoutContracts.scrollForms: Keep one original bounded scroll viewport, natural-height form content and fixed footer outside it. Preserve positive local-list heights and functional preview regions; no arbitrary hiding or collapse of plain Views.
layoutContracts.formLabelsAndFooters: Noninteractive labels align START. Supported v_lay_bottom groups with original return/yes controls retain original buttons, note inputs and clickable enable controls in one WrapLayout; note inputs have 160dp minimum width. The real door toggle/return/confirm footer stays outside the original scroll viewport.
layoutContracts.mappingForms: Log/key/broadcast/door forms retain original fields/local lists, composing each label, input and optional selector on a compact row. Five real log-check options use a responsive grid.
layoutContracts.inlineTargets: Set the inner standard LinearLayout minimum to 52dp as well as the outer original target, preventing real enable controls collapsing when ConstraintLayout ignores its own minimum.
layoutContracts.fileMenus: Keep original t1 action rows and APK-information Views through show-before-data, hidden information and late metadata. Hidden information reserves no blank panel; original callbacks/data remain authoritative.
layoutContracts.downloadRegions: Split file browsing from incoming links/tasks; measure actual six-command toolbars at natural row height, retaining original status/QR/history/help ownership and adapter-driven guidance.
layoutContracts.editorHost: CodeEditor keeps v_root as its direct late-content host and original top/bottom anchors. Only toolbar height is explicit; SurfaceView fixture checks do not execute the real editor.
layoutContracts.sidebarPreview: Preserve original sidebar-appearance preview coordinates and functional left/right/bottom regions.
layoutContracts.help: Keep full original mapping/help text without ellipsis or line-limit truncation; distinguish it from the short functions-version footer.
layoutContracts.themeRail: Center the existing theme TextView beneath its icon; the reported defect is text position. Mono/day brand mark uses rail foreground for contrast.
layoutContracts.artwork: Retain original colored app/control/storage/network raster artwork, colors and aspect ratio. The legacy theme pass identifies authored Icons by drawable type and recolors them to current ink on live theme changes regardless of View ID, including ID-less file-toolbar icons after warm-to-cyan switching. Tint known monochrome controls or authored Icons only. Icons supplies intrinsic 24x24 bounds for legacy ImageViews.

narrative.northStar: 个人控制台 / Personal Control Console
narrative.overview:
A practical personal console for Chinese car-display users. The original reference establishes the warm orange and cream identity. The user has expanded that approved world to three selectable expressions: 暖橙 · 奶油, 冰蓝 · 荧光科技 and 黑白 · 墨镜阴影. They share readable Chinese system type, persistent dark navigation, explicit selection and the same real application workflows.

Warm keeps broad, rounded surfaces; cyan uses cool blue panels, bright selection and tighter outlined corners; monochrome uses neutral contrast, restrained corners and native shadow on app/favorite cards. Original business widgets remain the functional authority. Optional static/Canvas/video wallpaper keeps its own colors behind the application main shell; shared panel transparency and selectable borders are separate appearance controls. Shipping UI is native Java Views and Android drawables.
keyCharacteristics: Three complete, manually selected day/night palettes with paired foregrounds.
A persistent dark rail and clear labeled routes to real tools.
Role-specific app cards, category chips, checkbox rows, fields and wrapping actions.
Actual installed-app icons alongside the shared authored line-icon family.
Editable favorites with explicit add, rename, remove, move and recovery controls.
Optional app-shell static/particle/video wallpaper with preview, crop, Apply and Cancel.
Shared panel transparency and optional borders that preserve foreground and wallpaper opacity.

rules.name: The Paired States Rule
rules.body: Resolve fill, foreground, icon and focus stroke from the same theme and mode. Primary controls keep their on-accent foreground when pressed; neutral controls keep ink on surface-family fills.

rules.name: The Native Units Rule
rules.body: Keep geometry in dp, text in sp, and reflow tied to actual available native bounds. Reference capture pixels are not a fixed layout canvas.

rules.name: The Bound Content Rule
rules.body: Use each production layout's real IDs and row-binding contract. Verify visible labels inside ancestor bounds, footer separation, content-sized menus and visible custom-loader bounds; successful inflation and measurement alone are insufficient.

rules.name: The Viewport Roles Rule
rules.body: Distinguish fixed geometry, content-height selectors, bounded scroll viewports and actual remaining-space content before recomposing a parent. Preserve fixed actions and region-specific state layers; never infer a usable workspace from resource IDs or nonpositive height alone.

rules.name: The Modal Layers Rule
rules.body: Keep the frosted panel, sharp interactive content and native owner dim as separate roles. Refresh and release the in-memory sample at bounded lifecycle events, retain original close/dismiss callbacks, and apply the configured panel opacity once to the fallback or sampled material.

rules.name: The Surface Opacity Rule
rules.body: Apply transparency to shared panel material only, preserve foreground and wallpaper opacity, and keep QR quiet zones opaque. Use one compositing budget for the frosted snapshot and tonal fill.

rules.name: The Appearance Commit Rule
rules.body: Keep draft appearance changes local until Apply, a theme choice or a day/night choice commits them together. State that combined action visibly and keep Cancel unsaved.

rules.name: The Wallpaper Draft Rule
rules.body: Keep preview separate from saved wallpaper, render both without a shared veil, and commit only on Apply. Preserve the previous video URI grant on Cancel, release unused/replaced grants at their proper boundary, discard unsaved private image copies without changing originals, and stop rendering resources when inactive.

rules.name: The Original Widgets Rule
rules.body: Recompose original controls without replacing their IDs, instances, adapters, business data or click handlers. ResourceIndex supplies original resource identity, composition strategy and XML order; role styling runs after original binding.

rules.name: The Semantic Composition Rule
rules.body: Preserve compact clickable controls and unknown adapter-row structure. Compose known rows by their real label/icon roles, retain original focus/key callbacks, and keep action names visible for touch use.

rules.name: The Visible Alternatives Rule
rules.body: Keep editing, adding and recovery understandable through labels and explicit controls. Gesture support supplements those paths rather than becoming the only way to manage favorites.

dos: Do preserve all three user-approved themes and their separately authored day/night roles.
Do resolve foregrounds, pressed fills, icons and focus strokes as a complete scheme.
Do adapt native layouts to measured available width and let forms scroll vertically.
Do distinguish app cards, category chips, checkbox rows, fields and toolbar actions by native role.
Do preserve original widget instances, IDs, adapters, listeners and real business content.
Do verify production row labels, artwork, footers, menus and visible loading geometry against the real binding contract.
Do preserve fixed geometry, selector roles, original scroll viewports, fixed footers and full help text across representative layout families.
Do keep dialog content sharp over the bounded in-memory frosted panel and native dim, with a readable fallback and preserved callbacks.
Do preserve wallpaper colors and foreground opacity while applying panel transparency separately, with explicit draft commits and lifecycle-bound rendering.
Do retain actual app icons, the shared line family and labeled favorite-management alternatives.
Do label Robolectric binary-XML renders, test substitutions and device/runtime gaps accurately.
donts: Don't mix a foreground from one theme with a fill from another or invent automatic theme synchronization.
Don't extend the dialog sampling blur into page-wide effects or monochrome card elevation to every control.
Don't force old fixed-column arrangements or rigid horizontal forms into narrower native viewports.
Don't flatten settings into an unstructured vertical stack; preserve grouped hierarchy and responsive use of space.
Don't replace original controls with visual mocks or fabricate permission, network or vehicle state.
Don't flatten compact actions or unknown adapter rows, tint all legacy artwork, or give every dialog the same fixed height.
Don't assume every focusable view has a visible state drawable or every legacy target meets the minimum.
Don't treat preserved resource IDs and successful measurement as proof of visible, usable bound content.
Don't treat WRAP_CONTENT or every zero-height list as elastic, or reuse one revision's VM captures to accept a later APK.
Don't treat a wallpaper preview as saved state, discard the prior URI grant on Cancel, or equate app-shell backgrounds with system wallpaper.
Don't treat panel HTML/CSS, earlier finish verdicts or fixture previews as current full-runtime or device approval.
